name: team-8-agent Agent
description: This is an agent which will be used to read  agent to extract relevant tabular data from files and display plots

skills.name: team_8_agent Extract
skills.description: Reads relavant files and extracts tabular data which matches the user specifications. If no description is provided, all tables will be extracted. Input files can be any text based formats (.md, .csv, .txt, so on)
skills.usage_notes: Only for extracting tabular data from files. Input files can be any text based formats (.md, .csv, .txt, so on).
skills.output_format: JSON with keys: status, input_received, message

document_artifact_id.description: The input document artifact id to process.

table_description.description: How the user named the table and the columns in the data fields.

skills.name: team_8_agent Plot
skills.description: Reads tabular data from .csv file and generates scatter plots, line plots, bar plots, and histograms based on user specifications. If no description is provided, do not plot anything
skills.usage_notes: Only for creating plots from .csv files.
skills.output_format: JSON with keys: status, input_received, message

extracted_artifact_id.description: The file document artifact id to process.

plot_description.description: Plot based on the description provided by the user. If no description is provided, do not plot anything and request more details.
